# Modular Suits
MODsuits are back-mounted sealed suits that deploy a helmet, chestplate, gauntlets and boots. The suit parts and the modules that go into it are made at the [bold]Exosuit Fabricator[/bold] and unlocked through [bold]Experimental[/bold] research.
## Assembling a MODsuit
1. Research [bold]Specialized Hardsuits[/bold], then print at an Exosuit Fabricator: [bold]MOD shell[/bold], [bold]MOD core[/bold], [bold]MOD helmet[/bold], [bold]MOD chestplate[/bold], [bold]MOD gauntlets[/bold], [bold]MOD boots[/bold] and [bold]MOD external plating[/bold]. 2. Click the shell with the core to insert it, then [bold]screwdriver[/bold] the core in place. 3. Click the shell with the helmet, then the chestplate, then the gauntlets, then the boots. 4. [bold]Wrench[/bold] the assembly, then [bold]screwdriver[/bold] it. 5. Add the external plating, then wrench the finished unit. The plating's theme decides the suit's appearance, armour and complexity cap. 6. Wear the finished control unit on your back.
## Using the suit
- Use the [bold]MOD interface[/bold] verb (right-click the control unit) to see the parts, the installed modules and the complexity budget. This works while worn and while the unit is on the ground. - Use the [bold]Deploy MOD parts[/bold] action to deploy or retract all four parts, then the [bold]Toggle MOD activation[/bold] action to seal the suit. - The suit cannot be sealed unless all four parts are deployed, and modules cannot be installed or removed while the suit is active. A module also cannot run while the parts it requires are retracted. - Examine the control unit to see the used and maximum complexity. A module cannot be installed if it would exceed the theme's cap. - To install a module, open the wires panel with a [bold]screwdriver[/bold] and click the control unit with the module in hand. Remove it from the MOD interface. - The suit's own drain and every installed module's idle and active draw come out of the power cell in the core. The tables below list charge per second, plus charge spent per use for usable modules.
## Removing the cell or the core
- [bold]Power cell:[/bold] open the wires panel with a screwdriver. With the panel open, use the [bold]Remove power cell[/bold] verb on the control unit and wait for the do-after. - [bold]Core:[/bold] open the wires panel with a screwdriver, then hit the control unit with a [bold]wrench[/bold]. After the do-after the whole core comes out, with the cell still inside it. - Close the panel with the screwdriver when you are done.
## Basic modules
These are unlocked by [bold]Modular Suit Modules[/bold] research.
[bold]Module[/bold] [bold]Complexity[/bold] [bold]Power draw[/bold] [bold]Effect[/bold]
[bold]Compact storage module[/bold] 1 none Adds a small storage compartment to the suit.
[bold]Flashlight module[/bold] 1 0.4/s active A configurable helmet light; colour and range are set in the interface.
[bold]Emergency tether module[/bold] 2 0.4/s active A powered winch and grappling hook that reels you towards a target.
[bold]Welding protection module[/bold] 1 0.1/s idle A polarised visor overlay that protects the eyes from welding arcs and flashes.
[bold]Longfall module[/bold] 1 0.2/s idle Converts fall damage into charge, protecting you from long drops.
[bold]Thermal regulator module[/bold] 1 1.2/s active Cools or heats the wearer to a temperature set in the interface.
[bold]Glove translator module[/bold] 1 0.2/s idle Lets you use sign language over the radio from the suit's gloves.
[bold]Storage module[/bold] 3 none A larger storage compartment than the compact version.
[bold]Hydraulic clamp module[/bold] 3 0.4/s active Hydraulic arm actuators that lift and drag crates and other heavy objects.
[bold]Safety-first head protection module[/bold] 1 none Extra dampening plates inside the helmet that protect the head.
[bold]Eating apparatus module[/bold] 1 none A nanotech barrier over the mouth, so you can eat and drink while sealed.
[bold]Janitorial mister module[/bold] 2 0.4/s active A built-in space cleaner mister for cleaning up messes.
[bold]Bike horn module[/bold] 1 3 per use A shoulder-mounted bike horn. Honk.
[bold]Waddle module[/bold] 1 0.1/s idle Makes the wearer waddle.
[bold]Medical visor module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active A medical HUD in the helmet visor.
[bold]Diagnostic visor module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active A diagnostic HUD in the helmet visor.
[bold]Security visor module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active A security HUD in the helmet visor.
[bold]Health analyzer module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active Extends a health analyser from the glove.
[bold]Drill module[/bold] 1 0.4/s active Extends a mining drill from the gauntlet.
[bold]Ore bag module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active Magnetises nearby ore into built-in storage.
[bold]Internal GPS module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active Shows your exact coordinates anywhere in space.
[bold]Candela beacon spool module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active Deploys and spools Candela beacon tethers.
[bold]Reagent scanner module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active Shows the chemical contents of anything you examine.
[bold]DNA lock module[/bold] 1 none Locks the suit to your DNA, so nobody else can activate it.
## Advanced modules
These are unlocked by [bold]Advanced Modular Suit Modules[/bold] research.
[bold]Module[/bold] [bold]Complexity[/bold] [bold]Power draw[/bold] [bold]Effect[/bold]
[bold]Injector module[/bold] 1 0.2/s active Extends a high-capacity syringe from the wrist.
[bold]Patient transport module[/bold] 2 0.8/s active A hardlight bag that carries a patient in stasis while you drag it.
[bold]T-ray scan module[/bold] 1 0.4/s active A T-ray pulse that reveals pipes and cables under the floor.
[bold]Magnetic stability module[/bold] 2 0.4/s active Magnetic boots that stop you slipping in zero gravity.
[bold]Constructor module[/bold] 3 1 per use Extends a rapid construction device from the gauntlet.
[bold]Resin mister module[/bold] 2 0.8/s active Sprays atmos resin to seal breaches.
[bold]Cloaking module[/bold] 2 1.6/s active Projects a cloaking field around the wearer.
[bold]Magnetic harness module[/bold] 2 0.2/s idle A magnetic harness that returns dropped guns to the wearer.
[bold]Holster module[/bold] 2 none An internal holster that stores a firearm for extremely quick retrieval.
[bold]Projectile dampener module[/bold] 3 15/s active Weakens all projectiles in a radius around the wearer.
[bold]Criminal capture module[/bold] 2 0.8/s active Wraps a suspect in a hardlight bag that drags at full speed.
[bold]Defibrillator module[/bold] 2 1.2/s active Defibrillator pads built into the gauntlets.
[bold]Ion jetpack module[/bold] 3 20/s active Ion thrusters that let you fly in space using the suit's charge.
[bold]Radiation protection module[/bold] 2 0.2/s idle Radiation shielding built into the suit.
[bold]EMP shield module[/bold] 1 0.2/s idle Protects the suit and its modules from electromagnetic pulses.
[bold]Bluespace storage module[/bold] 3 none A storage compartment using miniaturised bluespace pockets.
[bold]Kinesis module[/bold] 3 1.2/s active Moves objects at a distance with a kinesis field.
[bold]Joint torsion ratchet module[/bold] 1 none Charges the suit's core as you walk.
[bold]Recycler module[/bold] 2 0.4/s active Collects trash and compacts it into usable material.
[bold]Shooting assistant module[/bold] 3 0.4/s idle Recoil and accuracy assistance for ranged weapons.
